mechanism: Fenofibrate may inhibit hepatic metabolism and increase propylthiouracil levels, while propylthiouracil can potentiate fenofibrate's effects on lipid metabolism and increase hepatotoxicity risk through additive hepatic stress.
action: Monitor liver function tests (ALT, AST, bilirubin) regularly; consider alternative antithyroid agent if hepatic impairment develops; monitor for signs of agranulocytosis and hepatotoxicity.
